d: Razia Sultan, the first female ruler of the Delhi Sultanate, lands in trouble and loses her kingdom when she falls in love with Jamal-ud-Din Yakut, an Abyssinian slave.

One of six children from a poor family, she was married at the age of 11, to a man who gave her parents a cow, and threw in a bicycle. Torn weeping from her mother's arms, she was used by her husband as a beast of burden, and taunted by the higher castes of the village where she now lived.

Sadma (1983) is an emotional drama about a young woman who, after losing her memory and regressing to childhood, is rescued by a kind man who cares for her. As he grows deeply attached to her, fate takes a tragic turn when she regains her memory but forgets him completely.
JB, a borderline psychopath, is attracted to Lalita, a beautiful, young woman. He forces her to marry him but she runs away on her wedding day by feigning unconsciousness.
